title: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend Anime Unveils Teaser Trailer
content:
Noa Is My Senior and My Friend anime unveiled a teaser trailer on Saturday. The anime is set to premiere in 2027 with studio feel. animating the series. The anime stars Rina Kawaguchi as Noa Saotome and Tomoya Ito as Rihito Otsuka. A visual was released last month.

Shinsuke Yanagi is directing the anime with Keiichiro Ochi is writing the series scripts. Yumiko Yamamoto is the character designer. Enma Akiyama writes and illustrates the manga the anime is adapted from. Weekly Young Jump has been serializing the series since 2023 and has 11 volumes in circulation. It currently has 12 volumes in circulation.

The series follows Rihito Otsuka, who works at a game company under Noa Saotome, an art director admired by her colleagues for her strong work ethic. However, Otsuka soon discovers a side of his senior that she keeps hidden from everyone else. Source: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend anime Official website , X (formerly Twitter) ©Enma Akiyama /Shueisha/Noa Senpai is a friend. Production committee

title: Singer LiSA and Voice Actor Tatsuhisa Suzuki Announce Divorce
content:
Singer LiSA and voice actor Tatsuhisa Suzuki announced on Saturday that they have divorced after nearly seven years of marriage. The announcements were made through separate statements on their respective official websites.

In her statement , LiSA wrote, "After repeated discussions based on mutual respect and consideration, this is the conclusion we reached together." She also expressed her gratitude to Suzuki, saying, "I am sincerely grateful for all the efforts he has made for our family." Regarding their child, she added, "We will continue to work together to raise our child as parents." She concluded by reaffirming her commitment to her music career while cherishing her individuality as LiSA.

Suzuki also announced the divorce in a statement on his official website, writing, "We have decided to end our marriage and pursue our respective lives." He further stated that he would continue his activities as a voice actor and creator, as well as fulfill his responsibilities as a father.

LiSA and Suzuki announced their marriage in January 2020. LiSA later shared the news of the birth of their first child in April 2023.

LiSA has been widely acclaimed for her contributions to anime music, with theme songs for Angel Beats! , Fate/Zero , Sword Art Online , Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei , and Kimetsu no Yaiba . She gained recognition in 2010 as the vocalist for Yui of the fictional band Girls Dead Monster in Angel Beats! before making her solo debut in April 2011 with the mini-album Letters to U.

LiSA has received numerous awards for their music, including the Best Theme Song award at the 2017 Newtype Anime Awards for "Catch the Moment" and the 2019 Newtype Anime Awards for "Gurenge." She also received the Best 5 Songs by Download award at the 35th Japan Gold Disc Awards in 2020. In December 2020, she received the Grand Prix at the 62nd Japan Record Awards for "Homura," the theme songs for Kimetsu no Yaiba: Mugen Ressha-hen . Her song "Gurenge" also received the JASRAC Gold Award in 2021 and 2022 .

Suzuki is best known for his role as Ban in Nanatsu no Taizai , Makoto Tachibana in Free! , Ken Ryuuguuji in Tokyo Revengers , Haru Yoshida in Tonari no Kaibutsu-kun , Hiroomi Nase in Kyoukai no Kanata , and Ouma Tokita in Kengan Ashura .

Suzuki was also active as a singer in the rock band OLDCODEX , serving as its vocalist under the stage name Ta_2. The band performed theme songs for several anime, including Free! , Kuroko no Basket , God Eater and Servamp . In December 2021, OLDCODEX announced that it would end its activities in April 2022, coinciding with the release of the second Free!: The Final Stroke anime movie and its theme song.

Suzuki has received several awards for his work, including the Grand Prix in the Voice Actor category at the 37th Anime Grand Prix in 2014. He also received the Male Character Voice Award at the Famitsu Awards 2016 for his portrayal of Noctis Lucis Caelum in Final Fantasy XV .

title: Korea's EBS TV Network to Premiere 5 Generative AI-Assisted Animated Series in December
content:
South Korea's public educational broadcaster Educational Broadcasting System (EBS) will premiere five animated series created using generative artificial intelligence (AI) technology, beginning December 1. The series were selected through the broadcaster's 2026 Generative AI Animation Series Co-Production Project.

The five projects were selected from 429 submissions, representing about 86 entries per selected project. The productions combine generative AI with traditional animation techniques, including stop-motion, 2D, 3D, clay animation, felt puppetry, and paper cutouts.

To showcase the selected works, EBS will establish a dedicated AI animation programming block on EBS 1TV, airing Tuesdays through Thursdays from 5:20 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. KST.

The first series, Coconini's Fairy Tale Adventure Team , will premiere on December 1 at 5:20 p.m. The musical fantasy follows a cheerful child named Coco and Nini, a magical stuffed toy, as they travel into fairy tale worlds, overcome challenges with their friends, and tell their stories through songs and dances.

Stories Told by the Night will follow at 5:35 p.m. The series follows Hyeon, a lonely child who feels overlooked by his busy parents, as he explores different story worlds with a small AI device named Bam and learns about emotions and relationships. Each episode explores themes such as understanding, patience, courage, and waiting, while incorporating different visual styles, including felt puppets, colored-pencil drawings, clay animation, and traditional Korean folk painting.

On December 2, Euphoria Quest will premiere at 5:20 p.m. The comedic fantasy follows four novice adventurers who become separated after a mysterious explosion in a dungeon. As they confront their troubled pasts and reunite, they work together to uncover the dungeon's secrets.

At 5:30 p.m., Monobooks Cat Bookstore will debut. The series follows Mono, a quiet cat who runs a bookstore and comforts animal customers through the books he recommends.

The fifth selected series, Yellow Socks Popo , is scheduled to premiere in March 2027. Set in a facility where discarded single socks end up, the story follows a protagonist who challenges an army of plain white socks and discovers the importance of individuality and uniqueness.

EBS also plans to rebroadcast Euphoria Quest every Thursday at 5:40 p.m.

According to EBS, the project aims to support emerging creators and explore how generative AI can complement traditional artistic techniques. Rather than relying solely on AI-generated visuals, the selected productions combine the technology with handmade aesthetics and creative storytelling.
author: ANN

title: 'LONA' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the LONA ( Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis ) original television anime announced additional cast on Saturday. The sci-fi original anime is scheduled to premiere in April 2027 on 28 MBS and TBS-affiliated stations in the Super Animeism TURBO programming block.

Cast Yamabuki: Hirofumi Nojima ( Hidarikiki no Eren ) Raimu: Shouya Chiba ( Kill Ao ) Negishi: Cho ( Trigun Stargaze ) Ginnezu: Junichi Suwabe ( Black Torch ) Benifuji: Asaki Yuikawa ( Eris no Seihai ) Kujirai: Hiroki Yasumoto ( Tongari Boushi no Atelier ) Takamiya: Yumi Uchiyama ( Yomi no Tsugai )

Takashi Katagiri ( Spy x Family Movie: Code: White ) is directing the anime at Wit Studio . Posuka Demizu ( Yakusoku no Neverland ) is designing the original character design, while Yuuta Iino ( Hataraku Maou-sama!! ) is designing the characters. Hiroko Sebu ( Kimi no Suizou wo Tabetai ) is composing the music.

title: Wit Studio's Original TV Anime LONA Reveals 7 More Cast Members, Confirms April 2027 Debut
content:
Wit Studio revealed on Saturday more cast members for LONA ( Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis ), a new original television anime by director Takashi Katagiri ( SPY×FAMILY Code: White film). The staff confirmed the anime will debut in April 2027, and revealed the series will air on TBS and a total of 28 channels in Japan in the "Super Animeism TURBO" programming block.

The cast, including previously revealed cast members, includes (from left to right in above image, character name romanizations are not confirmed):

• Minako Kotobuki as Ao, an engineer and researcher at LONA

• Anna Nagase as Sango, an apprentice researcher at LONA

• Hirofumi Nojima as Yamabuki, LONA's assistant lab manager

• Chō as Negishi, LONA's lab manager

• Shōya Chiba as Kurume, an apprentice researcher at LONA who lives with his grandfather

• Fūka Izumi as Mugen, an all-purpose robot who handles communication and defense at SPring-∞

• Junichi Suwabe as Ginnezu, the sole administrator of Mahora

• Asaki Yuikawa as Beifuji, Ginnezu's private secretary

• Hiroki Yasumoto as Kujii, Minister of the Digital Ministry

• Yumi Uchiyama as Takamiya, Minister of the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

Wit Studio describes the anime's story:

A broken world in the not-so distant future. Humanity is facing a new incident. "We're being attacked by humans who should be dead." The government has decided to request a specialized organization to deal with this situation. The Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis, commonly known as "LONA." Researcher Ao and her apprentice Sango will try to get to the bottom of the mystery by analyzing the brains of the dead. What do people think of, and what do they leave behind before they die? Countless memories engraved in the neural circuits. What did they see in those deep depths?

Akiko Nogi (screenplay for INU-OH anime film, Library Wars , I am a Hero live-action films) is credited for the anime's original story and screenplay. Katagiri is directing the anime at Wit Studio , which is also in charge of planning. Posuka Demizu ( The Promised Neverland manga creator) is credited for original character designs, and Yūdai Iino ( The Devil Is a Part-Timer!! seasons 2 and 3) is drawing the characters for animation.

Additional staff members include:

• Sub-Character Design: Ayumi Yamada, Keisuke Ōkura

• Image Design: syo5

• Art Setting & Mechanical Design: Satoshi Takabatake, Kazushi Fujii

• Art Director: Yumiko Kuga

• CG Director: Shigenori Hirozumi

• Directors of Photography: Kentarō Minegishi, Miori Miyagi

• Editor: Kiyoshi Hirose (editz)

• Color Design: Kanami Tanaka

• Sound Director: Shōji Hata

• Music: Hiroko Sébu

• Animation Producer: Kazuki Yamanaka

Wit Studio first teased the anime project during the Chayamachi Oshi Festival 2026 on June 20, and also opened a countdown website .

title: Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored Anime Announces Ending Song, January Debut
content:
The staff for the television anime of author Fudaya Sanmongarasu and illustrator Tomozo 's Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored ( Isekai Dо̄raku ni Akitara ) light novel series revealed on Saturday the anime's key visual, information on its ending theme song, and its January 2027 premiere.

Singer Sumina Maruyama created the ending theme song "Yorimichi Sketch" (Stopping-By Sketch) for this project as her first anime tie-in song.

The anime will premiere on the TV Kanagawa channel in January 2027

As if the universe heard him, his journey begins sooner than expected. On his way home, he suddenly finds himself stranded in another world-a strange, game-like place governed by levels, magic, skills, and other fantastical rules. And before he knows it, he's acquired tremendous power without even having to work for it. With that kind of strength at his disposal, three paths lie before him: side with humanity and become a hero, join the demons and unleash chaos upon the world... or choose neither and use his newfound power for nothing more than his own amusement. For him, the choice is obvious. And so begins one thirty-something nobody's journey through another world, living exactly as he pleases until he gets bored!

Sanmongarasu debuted the web novel on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in June 2016. The first light novel volume with illustrations by Tomozo shipped in Japan in April 2019, and the eighth volume will ship on November 30. SAA debuted a manga adaptation in Shufunotomo 's Hero Comic in July 2025. Shufunotomo published the manga's first compiled book volume on September 30.

title: 'Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom Zero' Reveals Production Staff, Theme Song, Main Trailer
content:
The official website for the Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom Zero ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero ) revealed production staff, theme songs, a main visual (pictured), and the main promotional video on Saturday. The prequel anime movie to Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom ) is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on January 15, 2027.

Staff Director: Mitsuo Fukuda ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ) Screenplay: Mitsuo Fukuda , Chiaki Morosawa ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED ), Shigeru Morita ( Kyochuu Rettou Movie script) NEW Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Hisashi Hirai ( Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - The Beyond ) Chief Mechanical Animation Director: Satoshi Shigeta ( Code Geass: Dakkan no Rozé ) Mechanical Design: Kunio Ookawara ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: Cucuruz Doan no Shima ), Kimitoshi Yamane ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: Fukushuu no Requiem ), Manabu Shintani ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ), Zenseava ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ), Takuya Io ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ) Color Design: Akemi Nagao ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu 5th Season ) Art Director: Shigemi Ikeda ( One Punch Man ), Yukiko Maruyama ( Boku no Hero Academia ) CG Director: Mitsuhiro Satou ( Zegapain: STA ), Kensuke Kushida ( Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou 3DCG animation) Monitor Graphics: Azusa Tamura ( God Eater ), Jirou Kageyama ( Active Raid: Kidou Kyoushuushitsu Dai Hachi Gakari ) Director of Photography: Takeshi Kuzuyama ( Dr. Stone ), Ryou Iijima ( Hataraku Maou-sama!! ) NEW Editing: Yukiko Nojiri ( Gundam Breaker: Battlogue ) Sound Director: Sadayoshi Fujino ( Bakumatsu ) Music: Toshihiko Sahashi ( Tensai Ouji no Akaji Kokka Saisei Jutsu ) Planning, Production: Sunrise Production: Bandai Namco Filmworks

Note: The staff list includes members that have previously worked on previous entries in the franchise. The new members are denoted with legend NEW .

Takanori Nishikawa and Tetsuya Komuro are performing the opening theme "ABSOLUTE ZERO" and Japanese band See-Saw is performing the ending theme "Yuugure wo Matsu Nostalgia." Both theme songs are previewed in the main trailer below.

The original Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED ) television anime aired in 50 episodes from Fall 2002 to 2003. The 50-episode Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Destiny ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny ) sequel anime aired from Fall 2004–2005, followed by the Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Destiny Final Plus: The Chosen Future OVA in December 2005. The latest installment, SEED Freedom movie, opened in theaters in Japan in January 2024, grossing over 5.22 billion yen (approx. US$34 million).

title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Reveals Song Artists, January 5 Debut in Video
content:
The staff for the second television anime season based on Ran Kuze 's Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms ( Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsūjinai ) manga presented the full promotional video and a key visual on Saturday. The video announces the artists for the season's theme songs and the season's January 5 premiere.

The virtual YouTuber group duo HIMEHINA performs the opening theme song "Mechachū!!" (Amazing Smooch!!), and the idol group Straight Angeli performs the ending theme song "Hatsukoi no Distortion" (First-Love Distortion).

The new season will premiere on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on January 5 at 24:00 (effectively, January 6 at midnight). It will then stream on the d Anime Store , U-NEXT , and Anime Hōdai services in Japan.

Mona is the cutest girl in school, and she knows it. In fact, she's worked hard to make her High School Debut successful. But no matter what she does, she can't seem to catch the eye of stone-cold stoic Medaka Kuroiwa—but she's not about to give up that easy. Medaka, on the other hand, has been raised at a temple and was told to never become close to women. Who will win in this heated battle of wills?

Ryōta Iwasaki and Yū Serizawa reprise their roles as Medaka Kuroiwa and Mona Kawai, respectively, in the new season.

Yoshiaki Okumura returns to direct the second season at Synergy SP . title: Gundam Seed Freedom Zero Anime's Trailer Unveils Theme Songs
content:
The staff for Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO , the prequel to the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM anime film, unveiled its full trailer and a new key visual on Saturday. The trailer announces and previews the theme song "Absolute Zero" by Takanori Nishikawa with t.komuro, and also announces the ending theme song "Yūgure o Matsu Nostalgia" (Nostalgia Awaiting Twilight) by the group See-Saw .

The cast (which features returning members) includes:

• Kenichi Suzumura as Shinn Asuka

• Maaya Sakamoto as Lunamaria Hawke

• Houko Kuwashima as Agnes Giebenrath

• Daisuke Ono as Leonard Valway

• Sōichirō Hoshi as Kira Yamato

• Rie Tanaka as Lacus Clyne

• Akira Ishida as Athrun Zala

• Nanako Mori as Cagalli Yula Athha

• Tomokazu Seki as Yzak Jule

• Akira Sasanuma as Dearka Elthman

• Kotono Mitsuishi as Murrue Ramius

• Takehito Koyasu as Mu La Flaga

The English dub cast stars Matthew Erickson as Shinn Asuka, Matt Hill as Kira Yamato, and Sam Vincent as Athrun Zala.

The staff includes:

• Planning/Production: SUNRISE

• Original Concept: Hajime Yatate, Yoshiyuki Tomino

• Director: Mitsuo Fukuda

• Screenplay: Shigeru Morita, Chiaki Morosawa, Mitsuo Fukuda

• Character Design/Animation Director: Hisashi Hirai

• Mechanical Animation Director: Satoshi Shigeta

• Mechanical Design: Kunio Ōkawara, Kimitoshi Yamane, Manabu Shintani, zenseava, Takuya Io

• Color Design:Akemi Nagao

• Art Director: Shigemi Ikeda, Yukiko Maruyama

• CG Director: Mitsuhiro Sato, Kensuke Kushida

• Monitor Graphics: Azusa Tamura, Jirō Kageyama

• Director of Photography: Takeshi Katsurayama, Ryō Iijima

• Offline Editing: Yukiko Nojiri

• Sound Director: Sadayoshi Fujino

• Music: Toshihiko Sahashi

• Production: Bandai Namco Filmworks

• Distribution: Bandai Namco Filmworks, Shochiku Co. Ltd.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on January 15 and in North America in February 2027.

Director Mitsuo Fukuda , producer Hisakazu Naka , and Sōichirō Hoshi , voice of Kira Yamato, appeared at a stage greeting during the first screening announcing the prequel. They revealed that screenwriter Chiaki Morosawa and Shigeru Morita wrote the prequel's scenario while planning for Gundam Seed Freedom itself. In addition, Fukuda stated that the script for Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO was completed 20 years ago.

Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO's storyboards were nearly half finished, and the oldest storyboards actually predate those of Gundam Seed Freedom itself. The dialogue recording has also already been completed. Fukuda added that 20 years ago, Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO was originally planned as an original video anime ( OVA ), but the staff has not yet decided how it will be presented now.

Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM opened in Japan in January 2024. The film debuted at #1 in the Japanese box office. It sold 634,182 tickets for 1,065,983,130 yen (about US$7.20 million) in its first three days, marking the Gundam franchise 's highest three-day opening in box office earnings. The film is the highest-earning Gundam film in Japan ever.

Bandai Namco Filmworks and Fathom Events screened the film in the United States and Canada in May 2024. Netflix is streaming the film .

Special editions of the film screened in theaters in Japan in fall 2024. One version played with footage added to the end. Another special edition had different footage added (specifically, the above-mentioned teaser video).

Fukuda directed the film at Bandai Namco Filmworks . Fukuda also co-wrote the script along with his late wife Chiaki Morosawa and Liu Goto . Hisashi Hirai ( Mobile Suit Gundam Seed ) designed the characters.

title: 'Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Movie: Zankyou-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Main Trailer, May 2027 Premiere
content:
The Shadow's Gathering 4th Anniversary special livestream event revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), and the main trailer for the Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Movie: Zankyou-hen ( The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes ) sequel film on Saturday. The movie adapting Daisuke Aizawa 's comedy fantasy light novel is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in May 2027.

Cast Cid Kagenou: Seiichirou Yamashita ( Horimiya ) Beta: Inori Minase ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Akane Nishino: Yui Horie ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! ) Mordred: Takehito Koyasu ( JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken (TV) ) Yuuka Asakura: Yukari Tamura ( Higurashi no Naku Koro ni ) NEW Minoru: Rie Kugimiya ( Gintama ) NEW

Staff Music: Kenichiro Suehiro ( Yomi no Tsugai ) Music Production: Kadokawa Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai ) Sound Production: Magic Capsule Distribution: Animec

Note: The staff denoted with the legend NEW are new in their respective roles .

Kazuya Nakanishi ( Comic Girls ) returns to direct the movie at Nexus , with Kanichi Katou ( Black Clover ) penning the script. Makoto Iino ( Tatoeba Last Dungeon Mae no Mura no Shounen ga Joban no Machi de Kurasu Youna Monogatari ) is designing the characters.

Produced by Nexus, the 20-episode first season aired in Fall 2022. The 12-episode second season aired in Fall 2023. HIDIVE streamed the first season and simulcast the second season with an English dub.

Aizawa originally published the story on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in May 2018. Kadokawa began publishing the series under its Enterbrain label, with illustrations by Touzai , in November 2018. The seventh volume was released on April 1. The series has a cumulative 8 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Anri Sakano ( Mondaiji-tachi ga Isekai kara Kuru Sou desu yo? Z ) launched a manga adaptation in Monthly Comp Ace in December 2018. Kadokawa published the 19th volume on November 25.

The magazine also serialized a spin-off manga drawn by Seta U from July 2019 to September 2023. The sixth and final volume was released in October 2023.

A second spin-off manga titled, Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Master of Garden: Shichikage Retsuden , by kanco , began serialization in Comp Ace Comic Connect magazine in May 2024. The fourth volume went on sale on September 25.

Yen Press licensed the light novel and manga adaptation in English in May 2019 and January 2021, respectively. The sixth light novel volume went on sale in February 2025, with the seventh light novel volume going on sale in March 2027. The 15th manga volume was released on September 22, with the 16th volume scheduled for a January 2027 release.

A role-playing video game developed by Aiming, titled The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Master of Garden ), was released for Android, iOS, and Windows in Japan in November 2022. Crunchyroll Games launched the game worldwide for Android and iOS on the same day. The Windows version was released worldwide in May 2023, featuring cross-platform play and progression. A console game titled The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes is scheduled for release on May 14, 2027.
